title: 第5章  购买药材，自己炼丹！
content_zh:
“哥......”
方柔抓着方玄的手臂，小脸上满是担忧：“要么咱们逃吧，你斗不过他们的。”
不是方柔不相信哥哥方玄。
而是在方玄痴傻的三年中，方霄所展现出来的天赋、实力，甚至是手腕，都不弱于曾经的方玄。
声望和风头甚至一度盖过方玄，拥护者众多。
对于方柔来说，什么都没有哥哥的安危重要。
“小妹，你错了。”
方玄宠溺的揉了揉妹妹的脑袋，语重心长的说道：“有些事情，是躲不掉的。不仅不能躲，还要去争、去抢。”
他眼中凌厉之色闪过，沉声道：“小妹，你要就陪他们斗，哥不怕他们！”
笑了笑，方玄说道：“相信哥吗？”
“嗯嗯。”
方柔听得似懂非懂，但还是乖巧的点头。
“我哥哥是最厉害的！”
方玄看向战一，说道：“都跟我来。”
走进破败小院后，方玄大马金刀的坐在椅子上，面无表情的看着战一等人。
明明方玄什么都没说，但战一等人却没来由在方玄身上，感受到一股摄人心魄的威严。
他就如同一座巍峨山岳，仅仅矗立在那里，就令人窒息。
“哗啦！”
战一猛然跪下，垂首沉声道：“没有保护好少主和小姐，是我等失职，请少主责罚！”
“我要问的不是这个。”

方玄眼神一冷，说道：“十支护卫队，为何只有你们十人？其他卫队呢？”
家族护卫队一共十支。
按照方玄曾经的交代，除了在外历练的卫队之外，必须留下两支保护妹妹的安危。
但如今，只有战一这第十卫。
甚至都不在族中，这很反常。
“这个.......”
战一等人面面相觑，大气都不敢喘。
“说！”
方玄冷喝一声，稚嫩的脸庞上，浮现出一股久居高位的浓重威严。
霸道，凌厉！
“回少主，他们失踪了！”
战一俯身，以额触地。
“自从家主失踪后，兄弟们一直没有放弃寻找家主。”
战一说道：“两年前，统领收到消息，发现家主的下落，所以亲自带人寻找。这一去，就从此没有消息。”
“什么意思？”
方玄眉宇一扬，更显锐利。
“活不见人，死不见尸。”
战一的声音中，带着哽咽。
“这两年多来，我带着兄弟们四处打听，却一无所获，更是差点让少主和小姐遭遇意外，我等有罪！”
其余九人齐齐开口：“我等有罪，请少主责罚！”

听完战一的讲述，方玄也是长叹一声，倍感无奈。
沉默良久，方玄开口道：“忠爷离开之前，有没有告诉过你们，他们会去哪里？”
忠爷，是方家三代老仆。
也是家族卫队统领，虽然无甚实力，却对方玄这一脉忠心耿耿。
提到忠爷，战一嘴角一抽，摇头表示不知。
“罢了，都起来吧。”
方尘挥手道：“从现在开始，你们去城外据点修养，等我消息就好。”
战一一怔，满是担忧的说道：“那少主您呢？”
“不用担心我。”
方玄笑道：“经此一事，方家不敢拿我怎样。”
“还有，尽可能联系其他兄弟。”
方玄吩咐道：“别人我不知道，但忠爷绝对还活着。”
“是，少主！”
战一拱手道：“少主小姐保重，若有危机，我等拼死守护！”
等战一等人离去后，方玄眼中却是闪过一抹寒芒。
父亲失踪这么多年，他们一直苦找无果。
偏偏在他痴傻的这三年中，突然收到消息。
不用想，这绝对是个陷阱。
故意将忠爷等人引诱出去。
但若真是陷阱，以忠爷的智慧，又岂会看不出来？

还是说，这中间有什么他不知道的内幕？
既然想不通，方玄也就作罢。
当务之急，是尽可能提升修为，应付十日后与方霄的生死战。
此战，他必须胜！
武道修行，武脉为尊。
废脉为虫，不得修行；神脉为龙，翱翔九天。
那方霄觉醒地级武脉，可称天才。
再加上其所修功法武学，都非凡俗，战力绝对无比恐怖。
即便方玄获得九帝传承，凝聚混沌圣体，周身武脉尽数开启，天赋远超曾经。
但想要战胜方霄，也不是一件轻松的事情。
方玄要的，不是简单的胜利。
而是以绝对的实力，将对方碾压、击败、踩在脚下！
想到这里，方玄对正在忙活的小妹说道：“小妹，你乖乖在家，我出去一趟。”
刚才他已经展现过实力，想来方家人绝不敢再对小妹做什么。
......
天宝楼。
这是青阳郡最大的商会，没有之一。
功法、武学、丹药、武兵......各种各样的东西，只要你能想到的，这里都有。
同样，这里也是青阳郡最大的销金窟。
很多武者，为了一卷功法，一门武学，一枚丹药，就会豪掷千金，挣得头破血流。

没人知道天宝楼的背景有多深厚，只知道，即便强如问道宗的弟子，踏足天宝楼后，都要客客气气，不敢造次。
因为，曾有一名凝元境强者，在天宝楼中与人动手。
被天宝楼的护法强者，直接一巴掌拍成粉碎。
拼都拼不完整那种。
换了身衣服，乔装打扮一番的方玄，随着人流走进天宝楼，没有像那些初来者一样，东张西望，而是直奔某个区域。
这天宝楼，方玄来过不知道多少次，自然轻车熟路。
“尊敬的客人，请问有什么可以为您效劳的吗？”
这时，一名青衣侍女迎了上来，对着方玄恭敬行礼。
声音婉转，巧笑倩兮。
足以让心智不坚之人，被其迷惑，恨不得把身上的家底都掏出来。
方玄顶着一张黝黑的面皮，嗓音低沉，说道：“我来买些丹药。”
“好的，请随我来。”
侍女点点头，在前引路，身姿摇曳，却又不刻意露骨。
一切，恰到好处，浑然天成。
方玄目不斜视，脑海中盘算着所要购买的丹药。
“尊敬的客人，到了。”
很快，侍女带着方玄，走到三楼，专门出售丹药的区域。
硕大的三楼，矗立着无数柜子。
柜子上，摆放着一瓶瓶丹药。
已经有不少武者，正在天宝楼侍女的陪同下，挑选着心仪的丹药。

丹香和体香，交织在一起，让人心神略显振奋。
获得丹鼎女帝传承的方玄，立马就分辨出，这三楼的空气中，弥漫的是诱神香的气息。
和这些侍女身上的提神粉组合，可以搭配出一种清淡、雅致，却又能够无形中振奋武者心神的特殊香气。
若是再配合天宝楼的特殊话术，就能让不少低阶武者，不由自主的掏空腰包。
“客人，这边是疗伤丹药，这边是提升修为的丹药，这边则是可以凝练神魂的丹药，数量比较少。”
青衣侍女柔声道：“不知道客人，需要的是何种丹药？小玲可以为客人介绍。”
“气血丹三瓶，元心丹一瓶，龙骨丹一瓶。”
等对方说完后，方玄这才缓缓开口，却发现侍女一脸茫然的看着他。
“怎么，有问题吗？”
方玄看向侍女。
“气血丹和元心丹这里就有，而且品质都不低，保证让客人满意。”
侍女有些尴尬的说道：“只是这龙骨丹，奴婢也是第一次听说。”
“这样啊。”
方玄并不意外。
因为，知道这龙骨丹的人，本就不多。
“那麻烦带我去药材区域，我看看有没有炼制龙骨丹的药材。”
没有成品龙骨丹，方玄只能退而求其次。
“好，客人请随我来。”
相比之前，现在的侍女更加恭敬。
无论有没有龙骨丹这种东西，但敢扬言炼制丹药的，绝对大有来头。

要么认识炼丹师，要么......这位客人本身就是炼丹师。
但她猜测，应该是前者，
这位客人身上，可没有半点炼丹师的气质。
来到药材区后，方玄开始一一打量。
不愧是青阳郡最大的商会，即便是龙骨丹这种生僻丹药，竟然也能凑齐药材。
“这个，这个，还有这个......这七种药材，全部给我拿三份。”
方玄随手一指，找出自己所需药材，吩咐侍女。
“好的。”
很快，侍女将七种药材打包好，交给方玄。
“客人，若是您要炼制丹药的话，我们天宝楼就有现成的炼丹师。”
侍女介绍道：“因为是在本楼购买的药材，聘请本楼的炼丹师的话，费用优惠比较大。”
“不用了。”
方玄笑笑，说道：“我打算自己炼制。”
“啊？”
侍女吃惊的张大嘴巴，一双水汪汪的眼睛，扑闪扑闪的看着方玄。
“客人，您是说......您要亲自炼制丹药？”
方玄点头道：“有问题吗？”
“没......没有。”
侍女态度顿时一百八十度大转弯，恭敬的说道：“尊敬的炼丹师大人，我这就给您安排炼丹室，保证没人打扰您。”
天宝楼也提供炼丹室，方便一些炼丹师，在此自行炼丹。

收取的费用，比聘请炼丹师炼丹更少一些。
“有劳。”
方玄点点头，跟在侍女身后。
两人一路向下，最后在一楼的一扇大门前停了下来。
门口有两名大汉把守。
这两名大汉，虎背熊腰，气息雄浑。
其实力，竟然在聚气境圆满，比方岳还要强上一线。
青衣侍女和两人交谈了几句，那两名大汉好奇的打量了几眼方玄，随即点点头，将腰上的令牌按进门上的凹槽之中。
“咔咔！”
大门轰然
通道之中，灼热的空气扑面而来，让方玄微微眯眼。
content_en:
"Brother..."
Fang Rou grabbed Fang Xuan's arm, her face full of worry: "Either we run away, you can't fight them."
It's not that Fang Rou doesn't believe in her brother Fang Xuan.
But during the three years when Fang Xuan was stupid, Fang Xiao's talent, strength, and even skills were no weaker than those of Fang Xuan.
His reputation and limelight even surpassed Fang Xuan's for a time, and he had many supporters.
For Fang Rou, nothing is as important as her brother's safety.
"Little sister, you are wrong."
Fang Xuan rubbed his sister's head dotingly and said earnestly: "Some things cannot be avoided. Not only cannot they be avoided, but they must also be fought for and snatched."
A sharp look flashed in his eyes, and he said in a deep voice: "Little sister, if you want, just fight with them, I'm not afraid of them!"
Smiling, Fang Xuan said, "Do you believe me?"
"Yeah."
Fang Rou seemed to understand but still nodded obediently.
"My brother is the best!"
Fang Xuan looked at Zhan Yi and said, "Follow me."
After walking into the dilapidated courtyard, Fang Xuan sat on a chair with a straight face and looked at Zhan Yi and others expressionlessly.
Obviously Fang Xuan didn't say anything, but Zhan Yi and others felt a breathtaking majesty from Fang Xuan for no reason.
He was like a majestic mountain, just standing there was suffocating.
"Wow!"
Zhan Yi suddenly knelt down, lowered his head and said in a deep voice: "We failed to protect the young master and the young lady. We are negligent in our duties. Please punish the young master!"
"That's not what I'm asking."
Fang Xuan's eyes turned cold and he said: "There are ten guards, why are there only ten of you? Where are the other guards?"
There are ten family guards in total.
According to Fang Xuan's instructions, in addition to the guards training outside, two teams must be left to protect his sister's safety.
But now, there is only Zhan Yi, the tenth guard.
Not even in the clan, which is abnormal.
"This..."
Zhan Yi and others looked at each other, not daring to breathe.
"Say!"
Fang Xuan shouted coldly, and a strong majesty that had been in a high position for a long time appeared on his young face.
Domineering and fierce!
"Go back to Young Master, they are missing!"
Zhan Yi leaned over and touched his forehead to the ground.
"Since the owner disappeared, the brothers have never given up looking for the owner."
Zhan Yi said: "Two years ago, the commander received news and discovered the whereabouts of the family leader, so he personally led people to search for him. Once he left, there was no news from then on."
"What do you mean?"
Fang Xuan raised his eyebrows, which became even sharper.
"You can't see people alive, you can't see corpses even if you're dead."
Zhan Yi's voice was choked with sobs.
"For more than two years, I have led my brothers to inquire around, but found nothing. I almost caused an accident to the young master and young lady. I am guilty!"
The other nine people all spoke together: "We are guilty, please punish me, young master!"
After listening to Zhan Yi's story, Fang Xuan also sighed, feeling helpless.
After a long silence, Fang Xuan said, "Did Mr. Zhong tell you where they would go before he left?"
Mr. Zhong is an old servant of the Fang family for three generations.
He is also the commander of the family guard. Although he has little strength, he is loyal to Fang Xuan's lineage.
When Zhan Yi mentioned Master Zhong, the corners of his mouth twitched and he shook his head to express his ignorance.
"That's it, everyone, get up."
Fang Chen waved his hand and said: "From now on, you go to the stronghold outside the city to recuperate and wait for my news."
Zhan Yiyi was startled and said with worry: "What about you, young master?"
"Don't worry about me."
Fang Xuan smiled and said, "After this incident, the Fang family dare not do anything to me."
"Also, contact other brothers as much as possible."
Fang Xuan ordered: "I don't know about others, but Master Zhong is definitely still alive."
"Yes, young master!"
Zhan Yi cupped his hands and said: "Young master, take care, if there is a crisis, we will fight to the death to protect you!"
After Zhan Yi and others left, a cold light flashed in Fang Xuan's eyes.
Their father has been missing for so many years, and they have been searching for him to no avail.
But it's himDuring these three stupid years, I suddenly received news.
Don't think about it, this is definitely a trap.
Deliberately luring Master Zhong and others out.
But if it was really a trap, how could Mr. Zhong not see it with his wisdom?
Or is there some inside story that he doesn't know about?
Since he couldn't figure it out, Fang Xuan gave up.
The top priority is to improve his cultivation as much as possible to cope with the life and death battle with Fang Xiao in ten days.
He must win this battle!
When practicing martial arts, martial arts are respected.
The useless veins are like insects and cannot be practiced; the divine veins are like dragons, soaring in the nine heavens.
That Fang Xiao had awakened the earth-level martial arts and could be called a genius.
In addition, the martial arts and techniques he practiced were all extraordinary, and his combat power was absolutely terrifying.
Even if Fang Xuan obtained the inheritance of the Nine Emperors, condensed the Holy Body of Chaos, opened all the martial arts veins in his body, and his talent was far higher than before.
But defeating Fang Xiao is not an easy task.
What Fang Xuan wants is not a simple victory.
Instead, use absolute strength to crush, defeat, and trample the opponent under your feet!
Thinking of this, Fang Xuan said to the little sister who was busy: "Little sister, you stay at home and I'll go out."
He had already shown his strength just now, and the Fang family would never dare to do anything to their little sister again.
...
Tianbao Tower.
This is the largest chamber of commerce in Qingyang County, bar none.
Kung Fu, martial arts, elixirs, martial arts...all kinds of things you can think of are available here.
Similarly, this is also the largest gold selling cave in Qingyang County.
Many warriors will spend a lot of money and make a lot of money for a book of exercises, a martial arts, and a pill.
No one knows how deep the background of Tianbao Tower is. They only know that even if they are as strong as Taoist disciples, they must be polite and do not dare to make mistakes after setting foot in Tianbao Tower.
Because, there was once a strong man in the Condensation Realm who started fighting with people in Tianbao Tower.
He was slapped to pieces by the powerful protector of Tianbao Tower.
It's the kind that can't be completed even if you try hard.
Fang Xuan, who changed his clothes and put on a disguise, walked into Tianbao Tower with the flow of people. Instead of looking around like the first-timers, he went straight to a certain area.
Fang Xuan has been to Tianbao Tower countless times, so he is naturally familiar with the road.
"Dear guest, what can I do for you?"
At this time, a maid in blue came up and saluted Fang Xuan respectfully.
The voice is gentle and the smile is beautiful.
It's enough to make people with weak minds be confused by it and want to take out all their wealth.
Fang Xuan said with a dark face and a low voice, "I'm here to buy some elixirs."
"Okay, please come with me."
The maid nodded and led the way, her posture swaying but not deliberately revealing.
Everything is just right and natural.
Fang Xuan didn't squint his eyes, thinking about the pills he wanted to buy.
"Dear guest, we have arrived."
Soon, the maid took Fang Xuan to the third floor, where the elixirs were sold.
On the huge third floor, there are countless cabinets.
There are bottles of elixirs placed on the cabinet.
There are already many warriors, accompanied by the maids of Tianbao Tower, selecting their favorite elixirs.
The fragrance of elixir and body fragrance are intertwined, making people feel slightly refreshed.
Fang Xuan, who had received the inheritance from the Alchemy Empress, immediately recognized that the air on the third floor was filled with the scent of seductive incense.
Combined with the refreshing powder on these maids, it can be paired with a special fragrance that is light and elegant, but can invisibly invigorate the warrior's mind.
If you cooperate with Tianbaolou's special words, you can make many low-level warriors empty their pockets involuntarily.
"Guest, here are the elixirs for healing, here are the elixirs for improving cultivation, and here are the elixirs for condensing the soul. The quantity is relatively small."
The maid in green said softly: "I don't know what kind of elixir the guest needs. Xiaoling can introduce it to the guest."
"Three bottles of Qi and Blood Pills, one bottle of Yuanxin Pills, and one bottle of Dragon Bone Pills."
After the other party finished speaking, Fang Xuan slowly spoke, only to find that the maid looked at him blankly.
"What, is there a problem? "
Fang Xuan looked at the maid.
“Qi Xue Dan and Yuan Xin Dan are available here, and the quality is very high, so customers are guaranteed to be satisfied. "
The maid said with some embarrassment: "It's just the Dragon Bone Pill, this is the first time I've heard of it. "
"That's it. "
Fang Xuan was not surprised.
Because, not many people know about this Dragon Bone Pill.
"Then please take me to the medicinal materials area and I'll see if there are any medicinal materials for refining Dragon Bone Pill. "
Without the finished Dragon Bone Pill, Fang Xuan could only settle for the next best thing.
"Okay, guest, please come with me. "
The maid now is more respectful than before.
Regardless of whether there is such a thing as Dragon Bone Pill, anyone who dares to threaten to refine the pill must have a great background.
Either he knows an alchemist, or... this guest is an alchemist himself.
But she guessed it was the former,
This guest does not have the temperament of an alchemist at all.
After arriving at the medicinal materials area, Fang Xuan began to look at them one by one.
As expected of being the largest chamber of commerce in Qingyang County, it was able to collect medicinal materials even for rare elixirs like Dragon Bone Pill.
“This, this, and this…get me three copies of all seven medicinal materials. "
Fang Xuan casually found the medicinal materials he needed and ordered the maid.
"Okay. "
Soon, the maid packed the seven medicinal materials and handed them to Fang Xuan.
"Guest, if you want to refine elixirs, we have alchemists ready in Tianbao Tower. "
The maid introduced: "Because the medicinal materials are purchased in this building, if you hire the alchemist in this building, the cost will be relatively discounted. "
"No. "
Fang Xuan smiled and said, "I plan to refine it myself. "
"ah? "
The maid opened her mouth wide in surprise and looked at Fang Xuan with a pair of watery eyes.
"Guest, you mean... you want to refine the elixir yourself? "
Fang Xuan nodded and said, "Is there any problem? "
“No…no. "
The maid's attitude suddenly changed 180 degrees, and she said respectfully: "Dear alchemist, I will arrange an alchemy room for you right now, and make sure no one disturbs you. "
Tianbao Tower also provides an alchemy room, which is convenient for some alchemists to make their own elixirs here.
The fee charged is less than hiring an alchemist to make alchemy.
"Good work. "
Fang Xuan nodded and followed the maid.
The two of them walked all the way down and finally stopped in front of a door on the first floor.
There are two big men guarding the door.
These two big men had strong backs and powerful auras.
His strength is actually perfect in the Qi Gathering Realm, and he is even stronger than Fang Yue.
The maid in green chatted with the two men for a few words. The two big men looked at Fang Xuan curiously, then nodded and pressed the tokens on their waists into the grooves on the door.
“Kaka! "
The door bangs
In the passage, hot air rushed towards his face, making Fang Xuan squint slightly.
